tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la gser skyems 'dod dgu'i dpal ster bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la gser skyems 'bul bar 'dod na/ ja chang gi skyems phud gtsang sbra dang ldan par bshams la chab kyis bran la/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas byin rlabs rgyas pa kye rdor ltar grub na legs/ ma grub na/ oṃ las chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang / /āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher yangs par/ /hūm̐ las sha lnga ye shes bdud rtsi lnga/ /hoḥyis dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mchod rdzas de nyid mkha' khyab tu spel/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnod sbyin bek+tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon/ /pho nya lnga dang gaṇ+ḍi'i khro tshogs sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bcas pa la/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /sngags srung drag mo e ka dza ṭī dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo nam gru ma/ /bka' yi las byed gdong can rnams gnyis sogs/

/ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs bcas pa la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi sring mo bzhi/ /dregs pa pho bdun mo bdun srog bdud che/ /las shan nyer gcig zhing skyong 'bum sde dang / /dregs byed sde brgyad 'khor tshogs dang bcas la/ zag med= /bzhes nas= /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum/ /ber nag dang ni gcer bu zangs gri can/ /bran bdud gshin rje nag po sgo ma bzhi/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag tshogs dang bcas la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /nag po chen po'i tha tshig la gnas pa'i/ /gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pho nya'i tshogs/ /dpag med nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs rnams la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /dur khrod yab yum sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dmag zor rgyal mo bdud phrug ma mo bcas/ /las gshin yab yum 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma thams cad la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /bek+tse lcam dral las mkhan srog bdag dmar/ /ging chen brgyad dang ro shan nyer gcig dang / /btsan bdud ma mo the'u rang la sogs pa/ /'khor tshogs dregs byed rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma a tsa ra/ /sa brgyad sems dpa' sred spong rdo rje sogs/ /rang yul dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnas bdag la/ /zag med= /bzhes nas= /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ma bsnyel bar/ /bdag cag gang du 'gro ba'i sa phyogs su/ /dgra jag gcan rkun la sogs gzugs can dang / /gzugs med sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod 'tshe dang / /kha char rlung 'tshubs la sogs 'byung bzhi'i dgra/ /mtha' dag dmigs med dbyings su zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/

/khams gsum skye 'gro ma lus dbang du 'dus/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ltar 'bab pa dang / /bstan 'gro'i don chen yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi dkor nor rta phyug grwa 'khor rnams/ /dam can srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams la/ /bcol lo gtad do gnyer kha bzung ba dang / /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rtag tu ye shes spyan gyis nyer gzigs nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod phrin las rnams/ /thogs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / lam du zhugs khar yin na gser skyems 'gro phyogs su gtor/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas chos skyong 'khor bcas 'gro lam rnams su 'ur gyis gshegs nas lam dgra zhi ba sogs yid la gang 'dod kyi phrin las mdzad par bsam/ dus rgyun pa'i tshe rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la bsngo smon shis brjod gang 'os bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni sde bzhi dge ba bcu ldan gyi yul ljongs kyi ri khrod drwa ma sgang du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo rnams la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub rgyun mi 'chad pa mdzad pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la gsung ngag slob bshad sogs chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i slad du 'gro ba'i nyer bsdogs kyi skabs rnams su shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// //nam zhig sa gsum bla mar gyur gyi bar/ /mi dge'i bshes dang grogs ngan ring spangs nas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i gdams pas nyer 'tsho zhing / /rnam mang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i par 'di blo gros seng ges thar lam dgon du bsgrubs pa dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ sa skya'igaser skyems 'dod dgu'i dpal ster/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
